method: Read Klaviyo's pricing page (the 'Free' tab; the 'Marketing' tab's Email active-profiles slider at its default 500-profile position and moved to 1,000, 10,000, 50,000 and 60,000 profiles, plus the full 50-position slider sweep; the Composer, Professional Services and Enterprise tabs) with FAQ answers expanded, plus klaviyo.com/uk/pricing, the sign-up and About pages and Klaviyo Help Center articles on billing, plan changes, active profiles, mobile messaging and Composer, all in a US-locale headless browser; snapshots saved. An independent fact-check on 2026-09-27 re-read every cited figure against its snapshot and re-rendered the Marketing tab live, which still showed the same Email, add-on and SMS figures. On 2026-10-06 the 'Free' tab, the 'Marketing' tab (FAQ answers expanded; Email slider at 1,000, 10,000, 50,000 and 60,000 profiles; the Customer Hub and Social marketing cards' own sliders swept through every position) and the help center's billing article were captured again: the Email, Composer, Reviews and SMS figures were unchanged, and the Customer Hub and Social Marketing introductory discounts were gone.

freeTier.summary: Free with no time limit while the account stays at or under 250 active profiles and 500 email sends per month; it also includes $5 of mobile-messaging usage and $5 of Composer AI usage per month. Going over 250 profiles blocks sending until you are back under the limit or upgrade; hitting the 500-email cap blocks email until the next month or an upgrade. Email support is included only for the first 60 days after sign-up, then Community and Help Center only.

trial.summary: No time-limited trial of the paid Email plan: Klaviyo offers a free-forever plan instead (250 active profiles, 500 emails/month). The pricing calculator labels the separate Customer Hub add-on 'FREE 30-DAY TRIAL'. Whether a payment card is needed at sign-up was not confirmed: the captured sign-up page shows only the first step (email and password), not the later 'Company' and 'About you' steps.

plans.name: Email (500 active profiles)
plans.note: Smallest paid Email tier. A time-limited promo shown at exactly this tier ('$19 off your first month of Klaviyo Email (500 profiles only)') cuts the first month to $1; $20/month is the recurring price. The pricing page offers no annual billing.

plans.name: Email (1,000 active profiles)
plans.note: Klaviyo's Email plan is priced by active-profile count on a continuous tier scale, not a small set of named plans. This is the price at exactly 1,000 active profiles, with no promo applied at this tier.
highlights: Personalized email campaigns and automated flows

plans.name: Email (150,000+ active profiles)
plans.note: Above 150,000 active profiles the calculator shows 'Talk to sales' instead of a price. The Enterprise tab sells custom 'Klaviyo Standard' and 'Klaviyo Advanced' plans through sales only, with no published price.

addOns.name: Composer (AI marketing agent add-on)
addOns.unit: per month, flat (layers onto any Email plan; not priced by active profiles)
addOns.note: Every account also gets a smaller free Composer allotment automatically; this $20/month upgrade gives 4x that free allotment (help.klaviyo.com, source 22). Usage is metered in dynamic AI credits rather than a fixed action count — Klaviyo's own published ranges put 'Create a campaign' at $0.10–$10.00 and 'Analyze data' at $0.35–$0.90 per action (source 22). Unused credits expire at the end of each billing period.

addOns.name: Composer: additional usage (Flexible Overage)
addOns.unit: per 1,000 credits, charged once you exceed your Composer plan's monthly credit allotment
addOns.note: Optional; only applies if you opt in to Flexible Overages. Klaviyo bills the full $10 at the time of use regardless of how much of the 1,000-credit increment you actually need, and repeated overages in one billing period each incur their own $10 charge. You can opt out and instead pause Composer until the next billing cycle.

addOns.name: Customer Hub
addOns.unit: per month for up to 10,000 active profiles (rises with active-profile count above that)
addOns.note: Klaviyo's help center: 'Customer Hub is priced based on your active profile count, starting at $20 per month for up to 10,000 active profiles' (source 14). On 6 October 2026 the pricing calculator showed the same $20 at every Customer Hub tier from 500 to 10,000 profiles, with no discount label and no higher list price (sources 2-4, 24). Until 30 September 2026 the calculator had shown that $20 as a 30%-off 'special introductory' price off a $30 list price; once the offer ended, $20 stayed as the price shown. Above 10,000 profiles the price rises with each tier: $21 at 10,500, $50 at 25,000, $86 at 50,000, $103 at 60,000 and $235 at 150,000, with 'Talk to sales' above 150,000 (sources 5, 6, 24). The calculator also labels Customer Hub 'FREE 30-DAY TRIAL'.

addOns.name: Social Marketing
addOns.unit: per month for up to 10,000 active profiles, Social Marketing's smallest tier (rises with active-profile count above that)
addOns.note: Social Marketing has its own coarser profile tiers, set by its own slider on the calculator: $50 at 10,000 profiles, $125 at 25,000, $200 at 50,000 and $300 at 150,000, with 'Talk to sales' above 150,000 (source 24). Its card reads 10,000 profiles while the Email slider is anywhere from 500 to 10,000 profiles, 50,000 profiles at the 50,000 Email setting, and 150,000 profiles at the 60,000 Email setting (sources 2-6). Until 30 September 2026 the calculator showed these as list prices cut 25% under 'special introductory pricing' ($38 at 10,000 profiles, $150 at 50,000, $225 at 150,000); on 6 October 2026 it showed the list prices with no discount.

addOns.name: Reviews
addOns.unit: per month for up to 250 orders/month (Shopify and WooCommerce stores only)
addOns.note: Priced by monthly store order volume, not active profiles (source 14). Pricing above the 250-order tier shown by default on the calculator was not captured.

addOns.name: Professional support package
addOns.unit: per month, starting price ('Contact sales' for an exact quote)
addOns.note: Adds 2-24hr priority email response, weekend live chat during local business hours, one dedicated training session per year and a deliverability strategist on request, on top of the Standard support included with paid plans.

addOns.name: Enterprise support package
addOns.unit: per month, starting price ('Contact sales' for an exact quote)
addOns.note: Adds 1–12hr priority email response, 24/7 weekend live chat, two dedicated training sessions per year, and a dedicated solutions architect plus deliverability team.

usage.name: Outbound SMS — US, toll-free number
usage.unit: per SMS segment sent to a US recipient from a toll-free number (carrier fees included)
usage.note: The calculator shows '$0.01 + carrier fees* per send', with the footnote '*Price includes carrier fees where applicable'; Klaviyo's mobile-messaging FAQ confirms carrier fees are included in rates with no separate line item (source 19), and long messages are billed per segment (source 18). The calculator rounds to whole cents and did not say which Mobile Messaging subscription size this rate belongs to; Klaviyo says rates vary by country, channel, number type (toll-free vs short code) and plan size, with volume discounts on larger plans (source 19). SMS is sold through a prepaid monthly Mobile Messaging subscription, not pure pay-as-you-go. MMS, WhatsApp and RCS rates showed as $0.00 on the calculator and were not recorded (see unverified).

extraCosts.label: Email flexible-sending overage (optional)
extraCosts.display: Variable — next tier's extra email capacity, billed once at your plan's per-email unit rate
extraCosts.note: Only applies if you choose 'Flexible sending' as your upgrade preference and then send more emails in a month than your tier includes. Klaviyo's worked example: an $80/month plan entitling 35,000 emails (a $1.14-per-thousand unit rate) that needs 10,000 more emails is charged for the next tier's 15,000-email increment: 15,000 x ($1.14 / 1,000) = $17.10 (source 17). The alternatives are auto-upgrade (on by default for new subscriptions; permanently moves you to a larger tier, source 23) or 'None' (sending stops until the next billing cycle).

billingNotes: Self-serve Klaviyo plans are billed and renew monthly; the pricing calculator has no annual toggle and shows no annual-prepay discount for Email, Composer, Customer Hub, Social Marketing or Reviews. Contracted ('manually billed') accounts, available only at $2,000/month or more, can have monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual billing cycles set in the contract; any discount for those is not published.

Klaviyo enforces 'profile compliance': if your active-profile count exceeds your current Email plan's tier, you are automatically moved to a profile-compliant (more expensive) tier at the start of your next billing cycle, whether or not you opted into any auto-upgrade preference. The only way to avoid it is to suppress or delete enough profiles at least 24 hours before your billing cycle renews.

For email-send overages (sending more emails than your profile tier includes, while still within your profile limit), you choose one of: Flexible sending (a one-time charge for the next tier's extra sends, at your current plan's per-unit rate), Auto-upgrade (permanently moves you to a larger tier; on by default when you first buy a subscription), or 'None' (stops sending until the next billing cycle). You can also manually upgrade to a larger tier at any time; upgrades take effect immediately and you pay the difference for that first month.

The introductory discounts on Customer Hub (30% off) and Social Marketing (25% off) that the calculator showed on 2026-09-26 ran 'through 09/30/2026' and were gone on 2026-10-06: Social Marketing is back at its list prices, while Customer Hub's $20 starting price stayed and is no longer shown as a discount. The calculator still shows a 'Limited time' $19-off-first-month offer on the Email plan at the 500-profile tier only, with no end date on the page.

Cancelling immediately (rather than at the end of the billing cycle) forfeits the rest of the paid cycle with no refund; cancelling at the end of the cycle keeps the plan active, and billed, through its last day.

Self-serve customers pay month to month by credit card with no long-term contract. 'Manual billing' (an invoiced contract, ACH or wire) is only available once combined Klaviyo plans total $2,000/month or more, and is arranged through a Klaviyo representative rather than self-serve checkout.

Klaviyo's pricing FAQ, asked whether there are setup or onboarding fees, answers 'We do not charge hidden fees. Some plans include onboarding support — for larger implementations, we offer optional paid professional services.' No setup fee appears anywhere on the pricing calculator.

Composer, Customer Hub, Social Marketing, Reviews, Helpdesk, Marketing Analytics and Advanced Klaviyo Data Platform are all separate line items from the core Email plan; none is required to send email. This record captures the ones most relevant to an email-marketing buyer (Composer, Customer Hub, Social Marketing, Reviews) and scopes out the Service/Data-platform products (Helpdesk, Customer Agent, Marketing Analytics, Advanced KDP).

regional.note: We captured klaviyo.com/uk/pricing (source 11) with the same US-locale/timezone headless browser (US egress through our proxy), and it showed the same '$5 of mobile messages/month' USD figures as the US Free-tab page, not GBP. The Marketing-tab calculator elsewhere shows a country/currency selector (captured as '🇺🇸 USD'), so pricing may be personalized by a visitor's real geo-IP or an explicit selector rather than by the URL path; we could not test a genuine non-US locale/IP, so we can't confirm whether GBP or other local-currency pricing exists for visitors actually located outside the US. All prices in this record are the US list price in USD.

scenarios.label: Solo operator, 1,000 active profiles
scenarios.assumptions: One person, about 1,000 active profiles and roughly 4 campaigns/month, billed month to month. Klaviyo's Email plan is priced by active-profile count, not seats; the 1,000-profile tier includes 10,000 emails/month, above ~4 campaigns x 1,000 profiles = 4,000 sends.
scenarios.note: Composer, Customer Hub, Social Marketing and Reviews are all optional add-ons a solo operator could skip entirely; none is included here.

scenarios.label: Small team, 10,000 active profiles
scenarios.assumptions: About 10,000 active profiles and roughly 8 campaigns/month, billed month to month. The 10,000-profile tier includes 100,000 emails/month, above ~8 campaigns x 10,000 profiles = 80,000 sends.
scenarios.note: Composer ($20/month) or Customer Hub ($20/month for up to 10,000 profiles) are optional and not included; neither is required to send email.

scenarios.label: Growing team, 50,000 active profiles
scenarios.assumptions: About 50,000 active profiles and roughly 12 campaigns/month to the full list, i.e. about 600,000 email sends/month, billed month to month. The 50,000-profile tier includes only 500,000 emails/month, so the send volume, not the profile count, forces the 60,000-profile tier ($860/month, 600,000 emails/month). Klaviyo lets you upgrade to a larger tier at any time, and auto-upgrade is on by default, so an account on the 50,000 tier sending this volume would be moved up anyway.
scenarios.note: If campaigns go to segments rather than the full list and total sends stay under 500,000/month, the 50,000-profile tier at $720/month is enough. Staying on that tier and using flexible sending for the extra 100,000 emails would cost about $144 on top (100,000 x $720 / 500,000 emails), more than the $140 difference to the 60,000 tier. Add-ons (Composer, Customer Hub, Social Marketing, Reviews) are optional and not included.

unverified: MMS, WhatsApp (marketing and transactional) and RCS (Basic and Single) per-message rates: the pricing calculator displayed all four at a literal $0.00 + carrier fees per send at every tier we checked, which we don't believe is the real rate (Klaviyo's own help center says MMS costs more to send than SMS). We could not get the calculator to render a non-zero, channel-specific number, so these were left out of usage[] rather than record a figure we don't trust.
Reviews pricing above the 250-orders/month tier shown by default on the calculator (the Reviews card's orders slider was not swept).

Mobile Messaging's own subscription tiers and starting price: SMS is bought as a prepaid monthly Mobile Messaging plan, but Klaviyo's help articles give only example amounts ('$115 Mobile Messaging plan', a '$900/month plan'), and the calculator's Mobile messages card showed 'Monthly cost $40.00' without stating the message volume behind it, so no Mobile Messaging subscription price went into addOns.

Marketing Analytics (help center: starting at $100/month for up to 13,500 active profiles), Advanced Klaviyo Data Platform (help center example: $4,765/month for 1,000,000 profiles), Helpdesk (starting at $10/month for up to 50 tickets) and Customer Agent (starting at $50/month for up to 75 conversations) all have published starting prices in Klaviyo's help center, but this record is scoped to the Email/Marketing side of Klaviyo and does not verify or include these Service/Data-platform products as add-ons.
Whether a visitor with a genuine non-US geo-IP sees a different currency or price on klaviyo.com; see the regional note. Only US-locale/egress sessions were captured.
Exact Professional and Enterprise support-package prices beyond the published 'starting at $500/month' and 'starting at $1,800/month' figures; both require 'Contact sales' for a final quote.

Whether a payment card is required to create a free account: the captured sign-up page shows only the first form step (email and password). Klaviyo's help center says no card is needed to start the free Composer plan, but that article is about Composer, not account sign-up.

What accounts that added Customer Hub or Social Marketing at the introductory prices before 09/30/2026 pay now: neither the pricing page nor the help center's billing article, both captured on 2026-10-06, says whether those subscriptions move to the current calculator prices or keep the old rate for a time.

Customer Hub stayed at $20/month for up to 10,000 profiles, now shown with no discount label and no $30 list price.
